'''Siege Engineer''' is the skill associated with the '''siege engineering''' [[labor]]. Siege engineers make [[ballista]] and [[catapult]] parts in a [[siege workshop]],  and assemble those parts into stationary siege weapons, to be loaded and fired by [[siege operator]]s.
